data.final_week_advice: Conclude with a comprehensive review and timed practice to reinforce all topics and ensure confidence for the exam.
data.summary: The two‑week plan focuses first on the student’s weak unit (Acids and Bases) with a live class and targeted practice, then moves to a mixed review of kinetics and related topics with another live class, ensuring all units are touched and exam readiness is built.

weeks.focus: Master unit 8 concepts and apply them in practice
tasks: Attend live class #9100 (week 1) to review 8.1 and 8.2 concepts
Do 15 practice problems on pH calculations for strong acids and bases
Mark each solution against the scoring guide and note any errors
Review the class notes and summarize key formulas for pH and pOH

weeks.focus: Integrate kinetics and review key concepts for exam
tasks: Attend live class #4 (week 2) on rate laws and concentration changes
Complete 20 timed practice problems on rate laws and reaction order
Create a one‑page cheat sheet summarizing rate law formulas and common pitfalls
Simulate a mock exam section on kinetics using past AP questions
